# 0x001B AuxMobIndex create/click frames from the live 2026-06-02 net7
# captures. These are NPC/creature spawns (BuildCreatePacket) and the trimmed
# bodies sent when a player targets one (BuildClickPacket). The live net-7.org
# server talked to the real retail Win32 client, which rendered them, so the
# bytes are primary-source ground truth -- the CLI decoder reproduces them
# byte-exact via the dedicated AuxMobIndexDecoder. DO NOT edit the bytes.
# (Formerly mislabelled "newer ShipIndex divergence"; the producing class is
# AuxMobIndex, whose hand-rolled 15-byte masked flag block is not the generic
# AuxBase "present at bit N+4" layout.) See plans/11-phase-k-ingame.md.

[mobidx_cap1_273]

opcode: 0x001B
payload-bytes: 61
hex: 2C 87 01 00 37 00 01 16 04 00 44 00 00 0C 80 C3
     00 AE 40 F8 C0 07 06 00 43 72 61 78 65 6C 03 AC
     48 AF 1F A9 9F 43 37 00 00 80 3F 01 07 00 00 00
     05 05 05 05 05 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
